subject: Vendor onboarding: buyer intake, legal entity & banking verification (Oasis Health)
messages:

Cc: procurement@oasishealth.com
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference — Oasis Health

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call last week. We are ready to start the vendor setup so we can receive POs and enable ACH payments. To get things moving, attached are our initial tax and bank docs: Oasis_W9.pdf and bank_authorization_letter.pdf.

Please confirm the list of items your AP/procurement team needs from us to be added as a remit-approved vendor. The items we anticipate you'll ask for: legal entity name, EIN, full remittance address, ACH routing/account or wire instructions, and the PO contact for invoice routing. If there are any signed forms (procurement buyer intake, vendor terms), please send them over and we'll return by EOD.

We'd like to target PO issuance next week if possible — do you need a vendor code created ahead of the first PO?

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Sourcing Manager
Oasis Health
olivia.barnes@oasishealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference — Oasis Health

Hi Olivia — thanks for sending the docs and for the quick turnaround. Welcome aboard.

High-level: procurement needs the items you listed plus a couple of verification pieces from the bank to satisfy our finance risk checks. Below is the complete checklist — please return items 1–6 if you can, and we’ll open the vendor record and request a vendor code for PO issuance.

Required (please return):
1) Legal entity (exact legal name as registered) and EIN/TIN (copy of letter if available)
2) W-9 (you attached — we have the file but please confirm the signatory name)
3) Remit-to address for invoices (street, city, state, ZIP)
4) Payment method: ACH (preferred) or wire; if ACH, provide routing + account number and the account holder name exactly as bank records show
5) Bank proof: a bank authorization letter on bank letterhead OR a copy of a recent bank statement with account name & last 4 digits (we can accept the bank_authorization_letter.pdf you attached if it includes an authorized signature)
6) PO invoice contact and email (who will receive the PO and who to invoice)

Optional but helpful: beneficial owner attestation (for entity > certain thresholds), company registration excerpt, and remit contact phone.

Attached is our vendor intake template (redwood_vendor_intake_template.xlsx) — please fill the sheet labelled "Buyer Intake" and return it. If you prefer, we can set up a short form fill session (10–15 min) and capture details live. Once we receive items 1–6 we will: create the vendor record, kick off bank validation (micro-deposit or verification via bank letter), and route for PO enablement (we typically allow PO issuance within 3 business days after bank validation). Our standard payment term is Net 45 unless alternate terms are negotiated by Finance.

Next steps: please return the completed intake template and any missing docs. If you want to expedite ACH verification, let us know and Markus will open a finance ticket to prioritize micro-deposits.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_intake_template.xlsx]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oasishealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Redwood Inference — Oasis Health

Hi all — looping in finance ops (Logan) and adding a small ask from our side.

Thanks Olivia for sending initial docs. Two items to call out from a finance validation perspective:
- If you provide ACH, we will perform a micro-deposit verification (two small deposits) unless you provide a bank letter with explicit ACH authorization and bank contact. The micro-deposit is fastest for external partners.
- For wires, please include the bank's SWIFT/BIC and an intermediary bank if required for international routing. Also confirm if the account is USD-denominated.

Neha — if Oasis prefers to avoid micro-deposits, we can accept a bank-cleared letter on bank letterhead and a bank contact for verification. Logan, please prioritize the micro-deposit ticket when Neha triggers it.

Olivia — can you confirm: 1) account currency, 2) whether the ACH account is US-based, and 3) the PO invoice email so we can create the PO route? If you can return the filled intake sheet and signatory confirmation by end of day tomorrow (2027-06-22), we can aim to issue the first PO on 2027-06-24.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
